prompt:
Look at the time-series table in the image. It shows a spreadsheet-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, full grid lines, and a shaded header row. Answer this question about one row across the year columns. For Chuu, compute the sum over the year range 2023-2024.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered queried year-cell bounding boxes from the start year through the end year.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[488,180,600,236]],"answer":29}
